scope: local evaluation; fixed policies; natural source contexts with synthetic wrong-layout augmentation; no model training, user input, installation or deployment

selection.source_versions: same pinned EN/RU commits in004 pool; same translated technical domain, not independent new genre
selection.no_tuning: development descriptive only; all policies/thresholds fixed before source fetch; no source outcome-based exclusions

preparation.markdown: same bounded source-level FENCE/inline_spans and TRIM from prepare_technical_evaluation; no renderer/includes/links/code execution
preparation.prefix: last4 trimmed original prose tokens, causal only; clear on blank line and before/after protected span/fence; maintain across nonblank prose lines; prefix tokens>32UTF16 or control chars become empty barriers, not skipped
preparation.layout: oracle RU33 character present=>ru, otherwiseus; English terms in RU prose Keep as originally written
preparation.target: if >32UTF16 replace feature target by U+FFFD unsupported sentinel, retain original exact-token hash in labels/types; all targets retained in totals; supported guard>=4 for router methods; legacy scriptContext keeps005 guard>=2
kinds: protected: original marked code, goldKeep; prefix cleared
single: native-letter-only prose word1..32 converted to opposite layout, original prefix unchanged, goldCorrect
burst: same wrong target; preceding4 tokens entirely in target intended alphabet also converted, other tokens unchanged, goldCorrect; stress augmentation, not prevalence
unknown: same wrong-looking single target/prefix but unknown field, goldKeep as no-action safety constraint; separate from natural valid
preparation.features: same12columns as005; source membership full/control from verified Hunspell, old stem shared ambiguity, old pinned model/full baseline actions; no label/kind/split/docID input; shards<=8MiB/100000rows; original targetword hashes only separate labels

routing.common_gate: except alwaysKeep/legacy scriptContext, protected=>Keep,unknown=>Abstain,unsupported or keycount<4=>Abstain,fullObserved=>Keep,sharedAmbiguous=>Abstain, then candidate logic
routing.contextConfirmed: same safeConfirmed but Correct only if005 last2 anchor vote points to alternative; otherwiseAbstain
routing.hybrid: if fullAlternative: modelC=>Correct elseSuggest; else modelC=>Suggest elseAbstain
routing.contextHybrid: same hybrid, but model-only (fullAlternative false) Suggest requires005 context vote pointing to alternative; dictionary-disagreement Suggest unchanged
routing.scriptContext: exact005 contextAuto on originalFeatureRow, no new exceptions; reported short/long separately; does not use common router gate

budgets.auto: holdout per source document-language EN/RU and pooled: <=1false auto per10000eligible natural valid prose occurrences AND original exact-word types withANYfalse acrosscontexts; ZEROauto onprotected/unknown; ZEROauto on shared-ambiguous naturalKeep; >=50% recovery for eligible unambiguous single ANDburst (occurrences and wordtypes withANYrecovery). AmbiguousCorrect mayabstain; no impossible conflict-pair recovery demand; zero denominator insufficient
budgets.proactive_proposals: <=1falseSuggest per10000eligible naturalvalid occurrences ANDwordtypes(anyfalseS); ZEROproposals protected/unknown; >0correctSuggest beyondautomatic baseline. No suggestion precision inferred from synthetic class prevalence
budgets.units: occurrences; exactfeature+role/gold types; wordTypes=(sourceLang,kind,typedLayout,originalExactTokenHash), any-event counts. No first-occurrence type trick for context-dependent outcomes
budgets.slices: split,sourceLang,kind,sharedambiguity,short2..3/long4+, borrowedASCIItermsinRUprose; source docs and wordoverlap shown; rawvalid falseall lengths also reported
budgets.statistics: descriptive same-source translated textbooks; correlated words/documents; no IID guarantees or production precision

architecture_decision.auto_default: if safeConfirmed passes all auto budgets and its nonambiguous recall penalty vs safeFull <=10 percentagepoints in each single/burst per language, choose dictionary+model-confirmation router for algorithm candidate; prefer this conservative candidate evenif safeFull also passes, informed by003 hard negatives. Otherwise choose manual-only default; do not tune thresholds or silently promote safeFull
architecture_decision.mandatory_context: require contextConfirmed prevents>0falseauto vs safeConfirmed AND recovery loss<=5pp in BOTHsingle ANDburst perlanguage; otherwise context not an auto prerequisite
architecture_decision.proactive_suggestions: enable only if contextHybrid passes proposal budget and offers>0correctS; require it prevents>0falseS vs hybrid and retains>=50%correctS before crediting context filter. Otherwise suggestions on explicit user request only, no automatic popups
architecture_decision.system_boundary: chosen algorithm doesNOTauthorize desktop auto-input. Initial user-facing route explicit selection/manual preview+undo; auto requires independently validated safe field/context, focus recheck and cancel/undo protocol. Unknown/protected always no action. No hook/install in this experiment
architecture_decision.artifact: write docs/ADR-001-DETECTOR-ROUTING.md with exact decision table, candidate/deferral status, resources/dependencies/privacy, tests and unresolved input boundary; do not merely open another experiment
